changes.name: UpgradeSignAreaGuard
changes.source:
local world=workspace:WaitForChild("GrowIslandWorld")

-- Keep the entire upgrade-sign side clear of crystal decorations.
local function clearSignSide()
 local decor=world:FindFirstChild("CrystalExpansionDecor")
 if not decor then return end
 for _,obj in ipairs(decor:GetDescendants()) do
  if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
   -- Upgrade boards are on the west/left side (negative X).
   -- Remove crystals from that side so nothing appears behind the signs.
   if obj.Position.X < -25 then
    obj:Destroy()
   end
  end
 end
end

clearSignSide()
world.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
 if child.Name=="CrystalExpansionDecor" then
  task.wait(.2)
  clearSignSide()
 end
end)

-- Catch crystals that may be added later by another progression script.
while task.wait(.5) do
 clearSignSide()
end
